cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Mum's coming for lunch. Is this spoon clean enough for her? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You haven't cleaned the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. She checks cutlery. Could you check the forks while I finish this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told her to bring rubber gloves and help you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a guest towel. Can you help me choose one without a faded stripe?

mechanism: A claims to manage lunch preparations while recruiting B into small hospitality choices that distract from A uncleaned kitchen.
confusable: Unlike careful hosting, B must identify the larger neglected responsibility and A must sidestep it; authority depends on adopting B offered help as another detail.
comparison: A visiting mother and guest towel differ from a moving organizer focused on label colors despite empty boxes.
seedUse: Use D38-a spoon/forks/gloves/towel causal seed and S02-a adapting the official plan to B solution.
